reviews.name: Abdullah Abid
reviews.text:
The Soundpeats Q3 Pro are excellent earbuds. They are worth much more than every single rupee you spend on them. Trust me, all of those overpriced Zero Lifestyle, Audionic and Ronin earbuds are inferior compared to these. Let me just list the features first, and them my own experience with them. They have Bluetooth 6.0, Multipoint connection (ability to connect to two different devices at once), a very natural Transparency (or pass-through) mode, Feedforward ANC (Active Noise Cancellation) upto -38dB, Quad-mic system with AI ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation), Gaming Mode with an ultra-low latency of 80ms, IP55 Rated (sweat, dust, and splash resistant), 13mm Dynamic Audio Drivers with excellent audio engineering, and a companion app named "PeatsAudio" with tons of features such as customizable touch controls and gestures, a dedicated movie mode, lots of equalizer (EQ) presets, adaptive EQ based on personalized results of your own hearing analysis, find my earbuds feature (with help of both GPS tracking and ringtones) and even a built-in drainage system (to remove moisture or dust from the speakers).

My experience with these earbuds has been phenomenal. The Soundpeats Q3 Pro have exceeded my expectations, as the company claims 10hrs of playback time from a single charge of the earbuds whereas i got somewhere between 14-15 hours (with ANC on at 100% volume), moreover the company claims combined battery life of a fully charged case to be 42 hours whereas I got more than 46 hours. The sound quality on these earbuds was actually unbelievable because these earbuds have no business costing this cheap. If these earbuds costed around 6-8k rupees i would still buy them because I think they would still be worth it. 

The box also came with extra silicone-rubber tips for every size (small, medium and large), and a cute panda sticker pack.

Please buy these if you're looking to buy earbuds. I promise you will be glad you did. Also whatever you do, please don't buy anything from Zero Lifestyle, Audionic or Ronin in this price range. Trust me I have tested them all, they are not even close to the Soundpeats Q3 Pro in any aspect.
